newsitem.title: TUNISIA: Tunis bourse index closes up in lower volume.
newsitem.headline: Tunis bourse index closes up in lower volume.

text.p: The Tunis Stock Exchange on Wednesday closed up in lower trade, bourse sources said.
The market's 30-share index closed at 608.09 from 605.67 on Tuesday.
Trade volume was 1.4 million dinars against 2.547 million dinars.
Retail stores Monoprix MONO.TN was up 1.42 dinar to 48.82 dinars. Investment SPDIT-SICAF up 1.18 dinar to 40.58 dinars.
BIAT bank was down 1.9 dinar to 61.38 dinars. ATB bank down 1.76 dinar to 56.95 dinars.
